batch_limits.limit_1: Declared limit 1: what the Food and Drug Authority requires of pharmacies (the Rassd system: coding on the pack and batch standards) was read by title only, not in full — here a batch is part of core inventory, not a pharmacy profile.
batch_limits.limit_2: Declared limit 2: no field session was held with a pharmacist or food merchant — first expiring first out and refusing to sell expired stock were built from the rule, not from an observed shelf.
batch_limits.limit_3: Declared limit 3: no visual model was approved before the code — the layout of this screen is open to review, not final.
batch_limits.limit_4: Declared limit 4: stock with no expiry is issued after stock with an expiry — a layer without a batch has an unknown expiry, not merely an old one, and its batch is never guessed.
